name: to-do-mern
description: A full-stack MERN task manager with JWT authentication, full todo CRUD, inline editing, and filter tabs. Built with React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS 4 on the frontend, backed by a security-hardened Express 5 + MongoDB API featuring Helmet, rate limiting, input validation, and per-user ownership isolation.

paragraphs: A full-stack task management application built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Features JWT authentication, real-time toast notifications, responsive design, and a security-hardened backend.
features: User Authentication — Secure register and login system with JWT-based authentication and bcrypt password hashing
Full CRUD Operations — Create, read, update (toggle complete), and delete tasks seamlessly
Protected Routes — Unauthenticated users are automatically redirected to the login page
Ownership Isolation — Users can only view and manage their own todos, enforced on both client and server
Toast Notifications — Instant success and error feedback via react-hot-toast with a custom indigo theme
